name: muslim-day-android
description: Muslim Day Offline Android App — Prayer Times, Sehri/Iftar, Tasbih & Bangla Voice Reminders

scripts.android:init: npx cap add android && mkdir -p android/app/src/main/res/raw && cp audio/durood_reminder.mp3 audio/istighfar_reminder.mp3 android/app/src/main/res/raw/
scripts.android:sync: mkdir -p android/app/src/main/res/raw && cp audio/durood_reminder.mp3 audio/istighfar_reminder.mp3 android/app/src/main/res/raw/ && npx cap sync android
